components.name: Button
components.description: Starts an action or submits a form.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height: 28, 36 or 44 px.

props.name: tone
props.description: accent paints the solid and soft variants with the accent, danger with the fix colour.

a11y: A button that shows only an icon needs aria-label.
A button that switches something on and off takes aria-pressed.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: A square button that shows only an icon.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name and the tooltip text.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height and width: 28, 36 or 44 px.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Marks a button that switches something on and off; sets aria-pressed.

a11y: label is required: it is the accessible name and the tooltip.

components.name: Link
components.description: A link to another page or site, underlined with the accent.

props.name: external
props.description: Opens in a new tab, adds an icon and a hidden note.

a11y: The link text says where it goes; avoid "click here".

components.name: Text
components.description: Body text, in any step of the font size scale.

props.name: size
props.description: A step of the font size scale.

props.name: tone
props.description: muted and danger are for text on a ground, not on a soft fill.

props.name: mono
props.description: The monospace face, for code, ids and numbers.

components.name: Heading
components.description: A heading of level 1 to 4, in any step of the font size scale.

props.name: size
props.description: Defaults to the size that matches the level: 3xl, 2xl, xl, lg.

a11y: Keep levels in order; do not skip from 1 to 3.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: A key of a keyboard shortcut.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Lays children out in a column or a row with even gaps.

props.name: gap
props.description: A step of the space scale, in px.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Equal columns: three or more become two under 960px, and one column under 640px.

props.name: gap
props.description: A step of the space scale, in px.

props.name: collapse
props.description: Two columns under 960px when there are three or more; one column under 640px.

components.name: Card
components.description: A raised surface that groups related content.

props.name: padding
props.description: md is 16 px, lg is 24 px.

props.name: elevation
props.description: The shadow under the card: none, a low one, or the island's.

components.name: Island
components.description: A panel on the page with a title line, a large radius and the island shadow.

props.name: title
props.description: Rendered as a level 2 heading at the start of the head line.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the end of the head line.

props.name: padding
props.description: A step of the space scale, in px.

a11y: title is a level 2 heading: place an Island under a level 1 heading.

components.name: Group
components.description: A titled group of rows that the person folds and unfolds.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it starts open.

props.name: count
props.description: A number shown beside the title.

a11y: Built on details and summary: the keyboard and assistive technology work without script.

components.name: Row
components.description: A label beside its control, with an optional hint under the label.

props.name: hint
props.description: A short note under the label.

props.name: children
props.description: The one control beside the label. The label here names it.

examples.title: With a hint
examples.code: <Row label="Radius" hint="In pixels"><Input label="Radius" hideLabel type="number" /></Row>

a11y: The row's label is the name of the control inside. Pass the control its own label too and hide it with hideLabel.

components.name: Separator
components.description: A thin divider between groups of controls or blocks.

components.name: Bar
components.description: A bar of the kit's bar height with a start, a middle and an end slot.

examples.title: Three slots
examples.code: <Bar start={<IconButton icon="panel" label="Toggle sidebar" />} middle={<Text>Project</Text>} end={<IconButton icon="help" label="Help" />} />

components.name: Inverse
components.description: A block drawn in the colours of the other theme, light on dark or dark on light.

props.name: padding
props.description: A step of the space scale, in px.

a11y: Inverse paints only the colours; add padding with a Stack or a className.

components.name: Input
components.description: A one-line text field with its label, hint and error.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint and marks the field invalid.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height: 28, 36 or 44 px.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: What the browser may fill in, such as 'email', 'name' or 'off'.

examples.title: With an error
examples.code: <Input label="Email" type="email" error="Enter a valid email address" />

examples.title: Large, with a hint
examples.code: <Input label="Name" size="lg" hint="As on your card" />

a11y: Always pass label; use hideLabel to hide it visually.
Other attributes go to the input element; className goes to the wrapper.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line text field with its label, hint and error, which the person can resize by dragging.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint and marks the field invalid.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size and padding: the 28, 36 or 44 px control steps.

props.name: rows
props.description: The lines shown before the person resizes the field.

examples.title: A message
examples.code: <Textarea label="Message" rows={5} hint="We reply within a day" />

examples.title: With an error
examples.code: <Textarea label="Notes" error="Add at least one line" required />

a11y: Always pass label; use hideLabel to hide it visually.
Other attributes go to the textarea element; className goes to the wrapper.

components.name: Search
components.description: A search field with the search icon inside its box and a label that only assistive technology reads.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name, hidden to the eye.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height: 28, 36 or 44 px.

a11y: label is required: the field shows only the icon and the placeholder, so the label is its name for assistive technology.
Other attributes go to the input element; className goes to the wrapper.

components.name: Select
components.description: A native select with its label, hint and error. Its list is drawn in the page from the kit's tokens where the browser can do that; elsewhere the system's own list opens.

props.name: options
props.description: Array of { value: string, label: string, disabled?: boolean }.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown as an empty first option.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint and marks the field invalid.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height: 28, 36 or 44 px.

examples.title: A few options
examples.code: <Select label="Plan" placeholder="Choose a plan" options={[{ value: 'free', label: 'Free' }, { value: 'team', label: 'Team' }, { value: 'business', label: 'Business' }]} />

examples.title: Taller, with an error
examples.code: <Select label="Country" size="md" error="Choose a country" options={[{ value: 'pl', label: 'Poland' }, { value: 'de', label: 'Germany' }, { value: 'fr', label: 'France' }]} />

a11y: Always pass label; use hideLabel to hide it visually.

components.name: DateField
components.description: A date field with its label, hint and error, using the browser's own date input.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint and marks the field invalid.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height: 28, 36 or 44 px.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

props.name: value
props.description: A day as YYYY-MM-DD.

examples.title: A due date
examples.code: <DateField label="Due date" min="2026-01-01" hint="Not before January" />

a11y: Always pass label; use hideLabel to hide it visually.
The calendar is the browser's own picker; the kit does not draw one.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: A number field with a minus and a plus button at its ends, read as one box.

props.name: min
props.description: The least value; the minus button is disabled at it.

props.name: max
props.description: The greatest value; the plus button is disabled at it.

props.name: step
props.description: What each button adds or takes away.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value, a number.

a11y: label is required; the buttons are named "Decrease <label>" and "Increase <label>".
The middle is a native number input, so the arrow keys and typing work too.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A native checkbox with its label, drawn with a real edge and the accent when checked.
a11y: The label is the checkbox's name; always pass it.
className goes to the label row, other attributes to the input.

components.name: Radio
components.description: A group of native radio inputs in a fieldset, one choice of several, each with an optional hint.

props.name: label
props.description: The legend of the group.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name shared by the options.

props.name: options
props.description: Array of { value: string, label: string, hint?: string }.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the chosen value.

examples.title: Delivery
examples.code: <Radio label="Delivery" name="delivery" defaultValue="post" options={[{ value: 'post', label: 'Post' }, { value: 'pickup', label: 'Pickup' }]} />

examples.title: With hints
examples.code: <Radio label="Plan" name="plan" options={[{ value: 'free', label: 'Free', hint: 'For one project' }, { value: 'team', label: 'Team', hint: 'Up to ten people' }]} />

a11y: label is the legend and names the group; always pass it.
The arrow keys move the choice inside the group; Tab leaves it.

components.name: Switch
components.description: A native checkbox with role switch, for a setting that is on or off right away.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new checked value (a boolean).

a11y: The label is the switch's name; always pass it.
Use a Switch for a setting that applies at once, a Checkbox for a choice sent with a form.

components.name: Slider
components.description: A native range input with its label and the current value beside it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value (a number).

a11y: The label names the slider; always pass it.
The arrow keys change the value by step, Home and End jump to the ends.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.description: One choice of a few short options in a joined track; the chosen one carries the accent edge.

props.name: label
props.description: The group's name for assistive technology; it is not drawn.

props.name: options
props.description: Array of { value: string, label: string, icon?: an icon name of the kit }.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height: 28, 36 or 44 px.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the chosen value.

examples.title: View
examples.code: <SegmentedControl label="View" defaultValue="list" options={[{ value: 'list', label: 'List' }, { value: 'grid', label: 'Grid' }]} />

examples.title: Device, with icons
examples.code: <SegmentedControl label="Device" size="md" defaultValue="phone" options={[{ value: 'phone', label: 'Phone', icon: 'phone' }, { value: 'laptop', label: 'Laptop', icon: 'laptop' }]} />

a11y: label names the group; always pass it.
Built on radio inputs: one Tab stop, the arrow keys move the choice.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: A row of tabs over one panel; the tabs scroll sideways inside their own box on a narrow screen.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Array of { id: string, label: string, count?: number }.

props.name: value
props.description: The id of the chosen tab, when you control it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The tab chosen first; the first tab when absent.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the id of the tab the person chose.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the chosen tab: show the panel that belongs to value.

examples.title: Two views
examples.code: <Tabs tabs={[{ id: 'overview', label: 'Overview' }, { id: 'activity', label: 'Activity', count: 12 }]} defaultValue="overview"><Text>Overview of the project.</Text></Tabs>

examples.title: Controlled
examples.code: <Tabs tabs={[{ id: 'all', label: 'All', count: 24 }, { id: 'open', label: 'Open', count: 7 }, { id: 'done', label: 'Done', count: 17 }]} value="open" onChange={() => {}}><Text>Seven open items.</Text></Tabs>

a11y: Arrow keys, Home and End move between the tabs; only the chosen tab is in the tab order.
The children are the one panel of the chosen tab: render the content that belongs to it.

components.name: Nav
components.description: A list of places, as a narrow icon rail or a list with labels and counts.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the navigation.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of { id: string, label: string, icon?: icon name, href?: string, count?: number }. An item with href is a link.

props.name: value
props.description: The id of the chosen item.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the id of the item the person chose.

props.name: variant
props.description: rail is 52 px wide and shows icons only; list shows icon, label and count.

examples.title: Sidebar list
examples.code: <Nav label="Main" value="inbox" items={[{ id: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox', icon: 'note', count: 4 }, { id: 'sent', label: 'Sent', icon: 'arrow-right' }, { id: 'trash', label: 'Trash', icon: 'trash' }]} />

examples.title: Icon rail
examples.code: <Nav label="Tools" variant="rail" value="layers" items={[{ id: 'layers', label: 'Layers', icon: 'layers' }, { id: 'search', label: 'Search', icon: 'search' }]} />

a11y: Always pass label: it names the navigation for assistive technology.
The chosen item has aria-current; in the rail the item's label is its accessible name and its tooltip.

components.name: Menu
components.description: A button that opens a list of actions; it closes after a choice, on Escape and on a press outside.

props.name: label
props.description: The text of the button that opens the menu.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon name shown before the label.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of { id: string, label: string, icon?: icon name, danger?: boolean, disabled?: boolean } or { separator: true }.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the id of the chosen item.

examples.title: Row actions
examples.code: <Menu label="Actions" items={[{ id: 'edit', label: 'Edit', icon: 'note' }, { id: 'copy', label: 'Duplicate', icon: 'duplicate' }, { separator: true }, { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', icon: 'trash', danger: true }]} onSelect={() => {}} />

examples.title: With a disabled item
examples.code: <Menu label="Share" icon="external" items={[{ id: 'link', label: 'Copy link', icon: 'copy' }, { id: 'export', label: 'Export', disabled: true }]} />

a11y: Arrow keys, Home and End move between items; Escape closes the menu and returns the focus to the button.
A menu near the right edge of the page opens toward the left so it stays in view.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: The path to the current page; every item but the last is a link.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of { label: string, href?: string }. The last item is the current page; with an href it is a link marked as the current page.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the navigation.

examples.title: Three levels
examples.code: <Breadcrumbs items={[{ label: 'Home', href: '/' }, { label: 'Projects', href: '/projects' }, { label: 'Atlas' }]} />

examples.title: Two levels
examples.code: <Breadcrumbs label="You are here" items={[{ label: 'Settings', href: '/settings' }, { label: 'Billing' }]} />

a11y: The last item carries aria-current="page"; the separators are hidden from assistive technology.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Previous and next buttons with page numbers and gaps between them.

props.name: page
props.description: The current page, counted from 1.

props.name: pages
props.description: How many pages there are.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the page the person chose.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the navigation.

a11y: The current page has aria-current="page"; previous and next are disabled at the ends.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A modal dialog with a title and a close button.

examples.title: Confirm
examples.code: <Dialog open title="Remove item" onClose={() => {}}><Text>This cannot be undone.</Text></Dialog>

examples.title: With actions
examples.code: <Dialog open title="Discard changes" onClose={() => {}}><Stack gap="12"><Text>Your edits will be lost.</Text><Button tone="danger">Discard</Button></Stack></Dialog>

a11y: Esc and the close button call onClose; set open to false there. The focus stays inside while it is open.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A button that opens a small panel of content beside it.

props.name: label
props.description: The text of the button that opens the panel.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon name shown before the label.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which edge of the button the panel lines up with; it flips when it would leave the page.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the panel.

examples.title: Filter panel
examples.code: <Popover label="Filters" icon="filter"><Stack gap="8"><Checkbox label="Only open" /><Checkbox label="Mine" /></Stack></Popover>

examples.title: At the end of a bar
examples.code: <Popover label="Details" placement="bottom-end"><Text>Created on Monday by the team.</Text></Popover>

a11y: Escape and a press outside close it; Escape returns the focus to the button.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short hint over the one element it wraps, shown on hover and on focus.

props.name: text
props.description: The hint.

props.name: children
props.description: The one element the hint describes.

examples.title: On an icon button
examples.code: <Tooltip text="Copy the link"><IconButton icon="copy" label="Copy link" /></Tooltip>

a11y: Escape closes it. The element gets aria-describedby.
Never a control's only name: an icon button still needs its own label.

components.name: Toast
components.description: A short message that floats at the bottom of the page, with an optional action and close button.

props.name: tone
props.description: Shown as an icon and a bar in the tone's colour.

props.name: children
props.description: A line of text under the title.

props.name: action
props.description: A button or link, such as Undo.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button; called when it is pressed.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The close button's accessible name.

examples.title: With undo
examples.code: <Toast title="Item deleted" action={<Button variant="plain">Undo</Button>}>It was moved to the trash.</Toast>

a11y: It is a status region: a screen reader reads it when it appears without moving the focus.

components.name: Alert
components.description: A message that sits in the page, tinted by its tone, with an optional action.

props.name: tone
props.description: Shown as an icon, a bar and a soft fill in the tone's colour.

props.name: children
props.description: A line of text under the title.

props.name: action
props.description: A button or link that answers the message.

examples.title: An error
examples.code: <Alert tone="fix" title="Payment failed">Check the card number and try again.</Alert>

examples.title: A note with an action
examples.code: <Alert title="A new version is ready" action={<Button variant="outline">Reload</Button>} />

a11y: Tones review and fix use role="alert" and are read at once; neutral and good use role="status".

components.name: Icon
components.description: One of the kit's line icons, drawn on a 16 px grid.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in px.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Without it the icon is hidden from assistive technology.

a11y: Pass label when the icon carries meaning that no nearby text gives.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A short status label on a soft fill.
a11y: Do not rely on colour alone; the text must say the status.

components.name: Chip
components.description: A small tag, optionally with a button that removes it.

props.name: tone
props.description: A tone adds its soft fill and a dot of its colour; the text stays ink.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows a remove button that calls this.

a11y: The remove button is named "Remove <text>" when the children are a string, else "Remove".

components.name: Pill
components.description: A rounded label that becomes a toggle button when it has onClick.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon before the text.

props.name: pressed
props.description: On or off, for a pill with onClick. A pressed pill takes the accent border.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the pill a button.

a11y: A pill with onClick is a button and carries aria-pressed when pressed is given.
Without onClick it is only text.

components.name: Count
components.description: A round number, for a list's length or unread items.

props.name: max
props.description: Above this the count shows as "<max>+".

a11y: Put the count beside the text that says what it counts.

components.name: Dot
components.description: A small coloured dot that shows a state; its label is read out.

props.name: label
props.description: What the dot says, read out by assistive technology.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Fades in and out while work is in progress.

a11y: The dot is hidden from assistive technology; label is read out instead.

components.name: Swatch
components.description: A colour sample, optionally a button that picks the colour.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour.

props.name: label
props.description: What the colour is called: its accessible name and tooltip.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the swatch a button with aria-pressed.

a11y: label is the name of the colour; a swatch never carries meaning by colour alone.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A round picture of a person, or their initials when there is none.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name: the alt text and the source of the initials.

props.name: src
props.description: A picture; without it the initials show.

a11y: The name is read out; the initials themselves are hidden.

components.name: Table
components.description: A data table with sortable columns that scrolls sideways inside its own box.

props.name: caption
props.description: Names the table and its scrolling region.

props.name: hideCaption
props.description: Hides the caption to the eye; assistive technology still reads it.

props.name: columns
props.description: Array of { id: string, label: string, align?: 'start' | 'end', sortable?: boolean }. Use align 'end' for numbers.

props.name: rows
props.description: Array of objects keyed by column id; a value may be any node. A row with an id field keeps its key across sorts.

props.name: sort
props.description: { column: string, direction: 'asc' | 'desc' }: the column that is sorted now.

props.name: onSort
props.description: Called with a column id when its header is pressed. The table does not reorder rows itself.

examples.title: Orders
examples.code: <Table caption="Orders" columns={[{ id: 'name', label: 'Customer' }, { id: 'total', label: 'Total', align: 'end' }]} rows={[{ id: 1, name: 'Ada', total: '$40' }, { id: 2, name: 'Grace', total: '$25' }]} />

examples.title: Sortable
examples.code: <Table caption="Orders" hideCaption columns={[{ id: 'name', label: 'Customer', sortable: true }, { id: 'total', label: 'Total', align: 'end', sortable: true }]} rows={[{ id: 1, name: 'Ada', total: '$40' }]} sort={{ column: 'total', direction: 'desc' }} onSort={() => {}} />

a11y: caption is required; it names the table and the scrolling region.
A sortable header is a button and its cell carries aria-sort.

components.name: Progress
components.description: A progress bar with a label; it moves along the track while the length is not known.

props.name: label
props.description: Shown above the bar, with the value as a percentage.

props.name: value
props.description: 0 to 100. Leave it out while the length is not known.

a11y: label names the bar; aria-valuenow is left out while value is absent.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: A centred message that says nothing is here yet and what to do next.

props.name: action
props.description: What to do next, usually a Button.

props.name: children
props.description: A line of text under the title.

examples.title: With an action
examples.code: <EmptyState title="No projects yet" action={<Button tone="accent">New project</Button>} />

a11y: The title is plain text, not a heading; wrap the state in a section with its own heading when needed.
